name: Skills: create → edit → linked skills render → per-link toggle
description: Drives the Skills Lab end to end without an LLM. Confirms /skills lists the seeded skills, creates a skill from scratch, edits its body twice so the Versions tab shows v2, then opens Test Quality Reviewer's Skills tab and flips one link's checkbox off and back on. The only state this flow leaves behind is one extra skill named 'e2e-skill-08' (nothing else reads it); the agent link it toggles is restored to enabled in the last step, so flows 01-07 and a re-seed are unaffected. Deterministic locators only (--url / --text / find role|text|label) — no AI chat command, no model call.
